title: Geodetic Methods for Reconstruction Planning of Ageing Underground Distribution Infrastructure

record.title: Geodetic Methods for Reconstruction Planning of Ageing Underground Distribution Infrastructure
record.programme: Science Fund of the Republic of Serbia (PROMIS, IDEAS, Prizma)
record.summary: GEOMREKON investigates whether a combination of GPR surveys, precision GNSS and aerial photogrammetry can generate sufficiently accurate underground asset inventories to support cost estimation and route planning for distribution network reconstruction projects, replacing expensive manual test-hole programmes. The project tests three urban and two peri-urban study areas in the South Bačka and Srem districts. Deliverables include a decision-support GIS tool that flags cable and pipe segments exceeding age or condition thresholds based on as-surveyed depth, material classification and available failure records. The project involves doctoral supervision of two PhD candidates and collaboration with a regional electricity distribution operator providing access to maintenance records and operational data.
partners: Faculty of Technical Sciences, University of Novi Sad
